description: Per-role and per-agent overrides for the OpenRouter launch path, layered over routing/capabilities.json: defaults <- roles.<role> <- agents.<login> <- the agent's gitignored model-profile.local.json. Each layer may set `session` (the main conversation's model) and any `capabilities.<class>` model. `agents` is keyed by the Linux login — the agent — never by a directory name. Credentials are never here.

defaults.notes: The session model is the main agent's; the capability classes come from routing/capabilities.json unless a layer overrides one. A session on these defaults is a provider switch, not a cost switch.
